title: Adaptive probe tuning and auto-remediation Terraform module for VPC deployments
creator: Asha Patel
description: Implement a reusable Terraform/IaC module and supporting runtime components to deploy, configure, and manage adaptive health probes for Redwood Private (VPC) deployments. The module should provision: (1) a lightweight synthetic-request generator inside the customer VPC (k8s job or ECS task) to exercise model endpoints and emit latency, error-rate, saturation, and token-throughput metrics; (2) probe configuration (intervals, percentiles, token slicing) that supports adaptive thresholding based on recent baselines; (3) alerting/SLO hooks and remediation playbooks (scale-up, restart node pool, fallback model switch, circuit-breaker) wired to the customer's observability stack (Prometheus/Pushgateway, CloudWatch, or remote-write endpoint). Focus areas: safe defaults for private environments, minimal IAM/network footprint, guardrails to avoid noise/DoS (rate caps, backoff), and an upgrade path that is non-disruptive for existing VPC probe deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module deploys probe infra into a customer VPC with a single module call and documented inputs/outputs
Probes emit latency, p50/p95/p99, error_rate, token_throughput (tokens/sec), and saturation signals (CPU, queue length) to configured remote-write target
Adaptive thresholding computes rolling baselines and raises alerts only when deviation > configurable window (default: 3 std dev over 30m) OR sustained p95 breach for N intervals
Auto-remediation actions are configurable per-customer and include: restart service, scale compute, switch to compatible model variant, or mute noisy probe jobs
Module supports safe upgrade: new probe version can be deployed with canary probes and automated rollback on increased error rate
Documentation and runbook published with example Terraform usage, RBAC minimal permissions, and checklist for enterprise customers
tasks: Design Terraform module interface (variables, outputs, providers) and submit PR to infra-modules repo
Implement synthetic request generator as container image (configurable prompt prefixes, token budget) and publish image
Add adaptive thresholding component (lightweight service or library) and unit tests for baseline algorithm
Wire probe metrics to remote-write / Pushgateway / CloudWatch via configurable exporter
Implement remediation hooks: k8s restart, scale API, model-variant toggle, and Slack/PagerDuty ops alerts
Create canary deployment flow and smoke test harness for safe upgrades
Write docs: Terraform example, RBAC, best-practices, known limitations
Coordinate with Security for minimal IAM and with Product for customer-facing settings
updates: 2025-02-18: Ticket created to consolidate adaptive probes work into a single reusable Terraform module. Initial scope drafted.
2025-02-25: Spike complete — validated synthetic generator approach using sidecar job in k8s; initial container image prototype (registry/private-probes:v0.1) built.

2025-02-28: Chosen baseline algorithm: rolling-window percentile + anomaly detector with cooldown. Trade-offs: heavier math improves precision but adds compute; we settled on configurable sampling to limit cost.

2025-03-03: Terraform module initial layout pushed to feature branch (infra-modules/feature/eng-10458). Variables include probe_count, probe_interval, remote_write_endpoint, remediation_policy. Need PR review from infra and security.

2025-03-05: Implemented canary flag and automated rollback blueprint. Discussed safe defaults for private networks with Compliance: rate caps and egress restrictions required. Next: add Prometheus exporter compatibility and acceptance tests.
